label: TP
reason: Alert-TP driven by java/xss: User input from request.getParameter() flows through param.replace("\"", """) to bar, then embeds into HTML attribute at line 35. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled since replace() only escapes double quotes, leaving <script> tags unescaped. An attacker can inject <script>alert('XSS')</script> which renders as executable JS despite quote escaping.

evidence.note: User param flows to bar via replace(), then bar is concatenated into HTML attribute at line 35. Quote escaping is insufficient - angle brackets remain unescaped allowing script injection.
Sink expression writes user-controlled bar into HTML attribute without complete sanitization of XSS-delivering characters (<, >).
